commentary: DCE iron ore futures weakly throughout the day, the main contract I2501 closed 749, down 2.41% for the day. Traders showed a general willingness to sell, while steel mills procured at lower prices. The overall market transacƟon atmosphere was sluggish today. In Shandong, the transacƟon price of PB ﬁnes was 770-775 yuan/mt, down 10-15 yuan/mt from yesterday; in Tangshan, the transacƟon price of PB ﬁnes was 785 yuan/mt, down 10 yuan/mt from yesterday. The average daily pig iron output of the sample steel mills was 2.2672 million mt, down 15,800 mt MoM. However, according to the General AdministraƟon of Customs, China's iron ore imports in July increased by 5.4% MoM to 10,281,300 mt. The supply-demand mismatch of iron ore increased, suppressing iron ore prices. In the short term, iron ore prices may conƟnue to ﬂuctuate weakly.
